title: Quintessential Spicy Croatian Cheese Pasta
description: A spicy and satisfying Croatian dish that combines long-fermentation-dough pasta with molten cheese, perfect for midnight cravings.

ingredients.name: Kajmak Cheese
ingredients.notes: smoked Croatian cheese, can substitute with other smoked cheese

ingredients.name: Chili Flakes
ingredients.notes: adjust to desired level of heat

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: unsalted, for greasing the steamer basket

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the long-fermentation-dough pasta according to package instructions.
Meanwhile, in a separate pot, melt the butter over low heat and add the minced garlic.
Add the smoked kajmak cheese to the pot and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the paprika, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Once the pasta is cooked, drain it and return it to the pot with the cheese mixture.
Stir to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a bamboo steamer basket and steam for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is molten and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
